sources.title: Zeekr Australia online configurator (default model: Zeekr 7X)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. Zeekr 7X: Standard RWD $57,900; Long Range RWD $63,900; Performance AWD $72,900; Performance AWD Black Edition $75,900. Page states: Manufacturer's List Price (MLP) includes GST and excludes on-road costs (dealer delivery, stamp duty, registration, CTP insurance) and options; prices correct as at 01/11/2026 and subject to change. The Black Edition price is for a version this refresh did not scaffold.

sources.title: Zeekr Australia online configurator, Zeekr 009
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. Zeekr 009: 7 Seater FWD $115,900; 7 Seater AWD $135,900; 6 Seater AWD $139,900. This page states no price basis (before or after on-road costs).

sources.title: Zeekr Australia offers
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. MY27 Zeekr 7X launch offer, 1 November to 31 December 2026: complimentary premium paint, interior selection, two scheduled services, home wall charger, 5000 Z-Points and gift package for customers who purchase or place an order with deposit through an authorised dealer. No price change stated.

availability.note: Still listed with a Build & Price route; the MY27 launch offer refers to orders with deposit through dealers, but allocation, factory-order acceptance and delivery are not stated. Order status left as listed, unconfirmed.
